text: Capitol Correspondents Association ~ Annual Meeting January 19, 2021 ~ 12:15 p.m. MT ~ Via Zoom and in person in Capitol press room, EG15 Attending: Joan Cartan-Hansen, Betsy Russell, Chuck Malloy, Blake Jones, Catie Clark, Connor Swersey, Keith Rider, Melissa Davlin, Natasha Williams, James Dawson, Kevin Richert, Logan Finney, Rachel Spacek, Sally Krutzig, Margaret Carmel, Jeff Tucker, Sharon Fisher, Rebecca Boone, Hayat Norimine, Bill Spence Meeting began at 12:15 Welcome Betsy greeted members Approval of Minutes of 2020 annual meeting James Dawson moved to accept last year’s minutes; motion was seconded by Logan Finney. Motion passed Financial Report Betsy reviewed the financial report, which showed a balance of $1,324.13 on Jan. 1, 2021. Melissa moved to accept the financial report, Jeff seconded. Motion passed Presidents Report We adopted the respectful workplace and COVID-19 guidelines. Betsy sent out the Senate COVID-19 guidelines and reviewed them. She reminded members that she can be a liaison to leadership if needed. WIFI passwords have changed and are posted in the press room. Betsy encouraged everyone to enter the Idaho Press Club contest Officers Betsy, Joan and James have agreed to run for new 2-year terms on the standing committee. Chuck nominated this slate for re-election. Catie Clark seconded the motion. No other nominations were made. Slate elected. Media Access concerns Guidelines are posted in the press room and on the website. The Senate moved the chaplain to another seat so the press desk is available. James mentioned that some committee hearing/video audio is starting late. Jeff described some of “In Session’s” new technical problems. He encourages members to send him a note if they run into any issues or suggestions as they work through learning the new aspects of the service. Email address is idahoinsession@idahoptv.org. Dues Please pay online Other Business Melissa asked if any members had COVID concerns to reach out to the standing committee. Betsy reminded members that if any member comes down with COVID-19 and has been in the press room, that he or she should let a member of the standing committee know immediately. Logan extended a welcome to the McClure Center interns. Adjournment Melissa moved, and Connor seconded, to adjourn. Motion passed. The meeting adjourned at 12:39 pm
